improvements.title: CLI command ``magent ask``: Ask one question and print only the answer
improvements.description: Like ``run`` but the answer is printed alone, so it composes in a pipe.

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent chat``: Start an interactive session
improvements.description: An interactive prompt with slash commands (/help, /tools, /memory, /save, /quit). History is written to a session, so /save and --session let you come back to it.

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent plan``: Produce a plan without executing it
improvements.description: Produce a plan without executing it

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent reflect``: Run a task, then critique the answer
improvements.description: Run a task, then critique the answer

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent run``: Run the agent on a task
improvements.description: Execute one task with the full agent loop: tools, guardrails, memory, skills and session recording. Use --stream to watch tokens arrive and --format json to hand the result to another program.

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent memory``: Inspect, search and edit long-term memory
improvements.description: Memory is a hybrid BM25/vector store. `list`, `search`, `recent`, `add`, `forget`, `compact` and `stats` cover everything the agent can do to it.

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent rag``: Index files and query the retrieval corpus
improvements.description: Ingest documents, then search them. Chunks keep their source and line range, so an answer can always be traced back to the file it came from.

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent sessions``: List, show, export and search sessions
improvements.description: List, show, export and search sessions

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent trace``: Show the spans of the last run
improvements.description: Show the spans of the last run

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent bench``: Measure backend latency, throughput and cost
improvements.description: Measure backend latency, throughput and cost

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent eval``: Run an evaluation dataset
improvements.description: Score an agent against a dataset of cases with deterministic metrics (substrings, regex, JSON, tool usage, budgets) and exit non-zero below a threshold, so it can gate a build.

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent improvements``: Verify the improvements manifest
improvements.description: Every claimed improvement carries a reference to a real file and symbol. `verify` re-checks each reference against the checkout and fails when one no longer exists.

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent prompts``: List prompt templates and personas
improvements.description: List prompt templates and personas

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent serve``: Run the HTTP API and web UI
improvements.description: Starts a dependency-free HTTP server exposing the same tools, memory, retrieval, sessions and metrics the CLI uses, plus a single-page web UI. Use --background to start it from a script.

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent commands``: List every subcommand
improvements.description: List every subcommand

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent completion``: Print a shell completion script
improvements.description: Print a shell completion script

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent config``: Show, inspect and write configuration
improvements.description: Show, inspect and write configuration

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent cortex``: Query and control Cortex LLMHoster
improvements.description: The control plane behind the models: state, metrics, hardware, running models, the cookbook of known model recipes, model start/stop/restart, update checks and the auth options Cortex exposes.

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent doctor``: Check the installation and print fixes
improvements.description: Probes the backend, sandbox, guardrails, memory, sessions, plugins, skills and disk, prints one row per check with the fix for anything wrong, and exits non-zero when a required check fails.

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent init``: Write a starter config, skills and plugin
improvements.description: Write a starter config, skills and plugin

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent models``: List the models the backend reports

improvements.title: CLI command ``magent tools``: List, inspect or call tools
improvements.description: Without a name this lists every registered tool. With `inspect` it prints the exact JSON schema the model receives; with `call` it runs a tool directly, which is the fastest way to reproduce a tool bug.
